attributes.description: New Hire certification - This campaign is to verify access for new hires.

Create Certification Campaign.description: Creates a new-hire certification campaign so that the new hire's manager can review their access.

Get Access.description:
Finds entitlements this user needs that are not currently provisioned as part of an access profile or role.

This example finds entitlements related to "Travel Booking". Although these entitlements are not part of an existing role or access profile, the new sales team member will need this access, so the workflow gets those entitlements for use in the Manage Access step.

Get Identity.description: This node is used to gather information about the user's manager to populate their email.

Manage Access.description: Takes the results from the Get Access step for Travel Booking entitlements and submit it as an access request for the new identity.
